note: CoMaps (Organic Maps fork). Fixtures with source=capture are derived from a real CoMaps capture on Android 16 (2026-07-30, app.comaps.google). The FIELD STRUCTURE is real: the notification title is the distance-to-next-turn ('92 m') and the text is the road ('Kroonstraat'); the turn DIRECTION is only a graphical arrow icon, never text — so a capture with no icon match expects UNKNOWN. Since #74 the app matches the icon against CoMaps' own turn drawables and passes the drawable's name as iconDrawable; the icon-* fixtures pin the drawable → maneuver map. The distance uses a non-breaking space (U+00A0, written \u00a0 below) between number and unit exactly as the app formats it — this is the real byte, and it must extract. The street name is preserved from the real capture (a public street, not personal). Synthetic fixtures exercise units, the F-Droid package variant, and non-navigation notifications that must not match.
